name: ab_adsr
description: A/B: ADSR envelope — verify notes still play correctly WITH attack/release applied. Compares against ref WITHOUT ADSR (same pitches, different envelope).
script: # Reference: plain notes WITHOUT ADSR (from real Strudel)
strudel ref note("c4 e4 g4 c5").pianoroll() cps=0.5
announce REF: plain c4 e4 g4 c5 (no ADSR)
announce OURS: c4 e4 g4 c5 with attack=0.3 release=0.8
strudel edit note("c4 e4 g4 c5").attack(0.3).release(0.8).pianoroll() cps=0.5
# Pitches should match (freq check) even though envelope differs.
# Relax shape/spectral thresholds since ADSR changes the timbre.
